visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Recursion Instead of Nested Loops
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Three nested loops generate the permutations of exactly three items. Write a recursive function that works for any number of items and gives the same order. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Nested loops hard-wire the number of items: four items would need a fourth loop. The recursion adds one level per item and handles any length.
